```{r setup}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
# inputs: the ancestry run's genome-fit segments (agent/nb08/submit_anc_dip.sh) and zealhmm data/zeal/rtiger_50K_calls.csv
d <- "diploperennis_painting"
srcs <- c("SNP50K", "zealgt", "zealgt, wideseq")
read_beds <- function(glob, src) {
  rbindlist(lapply(Sys.glob(glob), function(f) {
    fread(f, col.names = c("chrom", "start", "end", "line", "state"))[
      , .(donor = sub("\\.genome\\..*", "", basename(f)), chrom, line, start, end, state, source = src)]
  }))
}
ours <- rbind(read_beds(file.path(d, "*.genome.segments.bed"), srcs[2]),
              read_beds(file.path(d, "wideseq", "*.genome.segments.bed"), srcs[3]))
srcs <- srcs[srcs %in% c("SNP50K", unique(ours$source))]
snp <- fread(file.path(d, "snp50k_calls_diploperennis.csv"))
snp <- merge(snp[, .(line = name, chrom = paste0("chr", chr), start = start_bp, end = end_bp, state, source = srcs[1])],
             unique(ours[, .(line, donor)]), by = "line")
dt <- rbind(snp, ours, use.names = TRUE)
dt[, chrom := factor(chrom, levels = paste0("chr", 1:10))]
dt[, source := factor(source, levels = srcs)]
dt[, row := match(line, rev(sort(unique(line)))), by = donor]
dt[, label := paste0(donor, "\n", uniqueN(line), " samples"), by = donor]
```

Per donor, the same lines in the same order in each block: SNP50K RTIGER calls on top, zealgt below. zealgt here is
RTIGER on the counts of variant-calling production run 1367152, fitted per donor over the whole genome at 1 Mb rigidity
(ancestry jobs 1387871, 1388677). zealgt, wideseq: the same fit on only the markers whose position, REF and ALT are in the
wideseq teosinte-vs-B73 panel (`bzeaseq/wideseq_ref`; filter job 1389323). `r uniqueN(ours$donor)` donors,
`r uniqueN(ours$line)` lines.

## Donor segments per line

```{r segments}
seg <- dt[order(source, line, chrom, start), .(segments = {
  s <- state > 0
  sum(s & !shift(s, fill = FALSE))
}), by = .(source, donor, line, chrom)][, .(segments = sum(segments)), by = .(source, donor, line)]
knitr::kable(dcast(seg[, .(median = as.numeric(median(segments))), by = .(donor, source)], donor ~ source,
                   value.var = "median"),
             caption = "Median donor segments per line, genome-wide (runs of HET or ALT).")
```

## Painting

```{r paint, fig.width=24, fig.height=26}
dt[, state := factor(state, levels = 0:2, labels = c("REF", "HET", "ALT"))]
ggplot(dt) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = start / 1e6, xmax = end / 1e6, ymin = row - 0.48, ymax = row + 0.48, fill = state)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(REF = "gold", HET = "springgreen4", ALT = "purple4"), name = "State") +
  facet_grid(label + source ~ chrom, scales = "free", space = "free") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = NULL, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), breaks = seq(0, 300, 100)) +
  labs(title = paste("Diploperennis lines, genome-wide:", paste(srcs, collapse = " | ")),
       x = "position (Mb)", y = "samples") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), strip.background = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.spacing.y = unit(4, "pt"), panel.spacing.x = unit(2, "pt"))
```
